target_customer: Enterprise AI and product teams (later customers named include Gusto, Vanta, Duolingo)
problem: Teams needed labeled data and then, after GPT-3 class models, a way to manage prompts, evaluate outputs and observe LLM apps. Humanloop moved from an active learning annotation tool to an LLM evals platform.
product_category: ML data tooling, then LLM evaluation and prompt management

founders.name: Jordan Burgess
founders.background_notes: Background in machine learning and engineering per the YC page.

exit.reason: Team joined Anthropic and the Humanloop platform was sunset on 2025-09-08. Press says the product and IP were not formally acquired.

technical_complexity.rationale: Active learning with NLP transfer models needed ML research skill from the PhD founders in 2020, and the later LLM evals platform required scalable observability.

defensibility.rationale: Labeling and later LLM tooling were crowded categories and the model providers could bundle evals; deep integration into customer workflows gave some switching cost.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model labs and clouds later built evals into their own consoles. Anthropic hired the team in August 2025 to build into its Console.

market_need_then: In 2020 transfer learning for NLP made small labeled datasets useful, and the founders cited a shortage of annotated data and ML expertise. Demand for LLM tooling arrived later after GPT-3 and ChatGPT.

branding.domain_note: Used humanloop.com; acquisition history of the domain not found.

identity.visual_style: Clean developer tool style; final site used a co-branded Humanloop and Anthropic graphic
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical but friendly, personal founder sign-off in the shutdown note

branding.community_and_virality: Founder podcast and conference talks (Latent Space, AI Engineer) built developer awareness; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Well known in LLM tooling circles through founder talks and blog content, but no sourced brand asset or community beyond that.

pivots.from: Active learning and annotation platform for NLP
pivots.to: LLM prompt management, evaluation and observability
pivots.why: Spotted GPT-3 instruction tuning breakthroughs per a founder account

outcome_analysis: Humanloop began as an active learning tool, raised a 2.6 million dollar seed led by Index in 2022 and pivoted into LLM evals as foundation models took off, winning enterprise customers like Gusto and Vanta. It stayed small and was absorbed in August 2025 when Anthropic hired the founders and most of the team and the platform was shut down in September 2025. This reads as a talent driven exit in a market where model providers were bundling evals, with terms undisclosed.
notes: Funding is partial. A 2.1M pound or dollar earlier raise (BusinessCloud headline) and a 5M seed plus in November 2023 led by YC appear in single snippets and are unverified. The company said it had raised about 8M total from YC Continuity, Index, LocalGlobe and angels. The batch is Summer 2020 per YC, with some sources saying Winter 2020. No competitor sources dated 2020 were found; later vendor blogs compare to Prodigy, Labelbox and Snorkel AI without dates. The 15M Series A attributed in some places belongs to Arthur.ai, not Humanloop. Exit type: sources dispute whether IP was acquired; directory status is Acquired.
